# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My top pick is the JBL Charge 6, at about $130-$150.** It's the best overall choice in several of the guides I found. It has an IP68 rating, 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), and it can charge your phone. What Hi-Fi praised its clear, detailed sound and tough build.
- Buy: [Walmart $129.99, Amazon $149.95 and Best Buy via What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart), or [Amazon, Walmart and Lowe's via Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) (listed at $150 there).

**Other picks by need**
- **Budget, floats, 360° sound: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4 (about $65-$80).** It's IP67, floats, and gets up to 14 hours of battery. It's smaller and not as loud as pricier options. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) lists Amazon, Walmart and Lowe's, and [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) also covers it.
- **Pool parties: JBL Boombox 4.** It's RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, survives long immersion, gets loud, and lasts over 40 hours. It's big and pricey, and its sound is directional. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) has Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart links.
- **Mid-range, even sound all around: Ultimate Ears Epicboom.** Tom's Guide's best overall and RTINGS' best mid-range pick. It's IP67, floats, and has 15 hours of battery. See [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) for Amazon and Newegg.
- **Easy to carry: JBL Grip (about $100).** It's can-sized, IP68, and gets 12 hours of battery. The mesh body can collect dust. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/a71783745/) lists Amazon, Walmart and Macy's.
- **Cheapest: JBL Go 5 (about $40).** It's pocket-sized with IP67, but battery is only about 8-10 hours. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) has Amazon links.

**Tips**
- Look for IP67 or higher. IP68 is better, and floating is a bonus at the pool.
- IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage. RTINGS recommends rinsing with fresh water after use, though some manufacturers advise against it, so check your model's manual.
- Close the charging port flap, and let the speaker dry before charging.
- At the beach, keep it on a towel. Sand and heat can still cause trouble.

**A note on the links:** the search results gave me review pages with retailer buttons, not direct product pages, so please check current prices and colors there. If you'd like a single model narrowed down, tell me your budget and whether you care more about loudness or portability.
